# ankra_cluster_state_snapshot_retention (Resource)

The retention window of a provisioned cluster's scheduled etcd backups (`ankra cluster state-snapshots retention`). Ankra backs up the etcd state every six hours to the organisation's backup vault and keeps the newest backups plus the newest one of each UTC day within the window. A shorter window deletes the daily backups that fall outside it, and a longer one cannot bring back backups already deleted, so the plan warns when the window shrinks. Every change is audited. Destroy leaves the window as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_cluster_state_snapshot_retention" "prod" {
  cluster_id     = "0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666"
  retention_days = 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `retention_days` (Number) Days the newest backup of each UTC day is kept, 1 to 90.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The cluster id.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether the window is the platform default.
- `keep_latest` (Number) How many newest backups are kept whatever the window.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by cluster id.
terraform import ankra_cluster_state_snapshot_retention.prod 0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666
```
